proposed_capability: P00 extends player-sovereignty ontology to any interaction shape across apps and mod/game; P01 strengthens the existing cooperative queue with atomic-effect entrypoint and retained partial intents for explicit reconciliation. Prefer semantic/native APIs; no peripheral configuration or unsolicited focus capture.
player_save_control_impact: No game input, save changes, Bluetooth configuration or keyboard preference writes. Minimized capture yields a gate error.
expected_outcome: All interaction shapes retain human authority. New atomic-effect queue wrapper checks idle immediately before effects. Partial callbacks preserve intent and require observed reconciliation plus remainder, never replay. Existing queue remains the sole waiter.
negative_tests: Human input in any application withholds effects
Explicit voice/busy holds even with stale input age
Partial interruption retains intent and cannot blind-replay
No desktop lock stolen or peripheral setting changes
rollback_path: Revert scoped contract and queue changes; no installed game, save or OS settings touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Unadopted external/raw agent adapters are not intercepted by this cooperative library.
No guarantee of preemption inside an already executing native call.
Live game cooperative behavior remains a separate acceptance gate.
